customManagers.description: The renovate version that CI's validator steps and the README's command install with npx.

packageRules.description: CI's Node stays inside the range renovate's engines declare (^24.11.0 as of renovate 44). On a newer Node, npx installs an old renovate major whose validator fails, as the Node 26 update did. Raise this when renovate's engines allow the next line.
renovate publishes several releases a day, and every pull request here needs a code owner's review. Take the validator weekly.
